definitions.gloss: wheat bran; outer layer of wheat grain
definitions.explanation: The outer fibrous coating of wheat grain that is separated from the flour during milling. Used in animal feed, as a dietary supplement for fiber, and in some baked goods.

examples.japanese: {麸|ふすま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{製粉|せいふん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧{副産物|ふくさんぶつ}だ。
examples.english: Wheat bran is a byproduct of milling wheat into flour.

examples.japanese: {麸|ふすま}⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食物|しょくもつ}{繊維|せんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧で⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よい。
examples.english: Bran bread is rich in dietary fiber and good for health.

examples.japanese: {麸|ふすま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれる→含む：01982_fukumu⟧⟦{食物|しょくもつ}{繊維|せんい}→食物繊維：15118_shokumotsuseni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The dietary fiber in wheat bran has the effect of improving intestinal health.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{糠|ぬか}→糠：29202_nuka⟧: rice bran — the outer layer of rice removed during milling, used for pickling (ぬかづけ)
- ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧: wheat flour — the white interior of the wheat grain after bran is removed

Not to be confused with ⟦{麩|ふ}→麩：24202_fu⟧ (fu), a wheat-gluten product used in Japanese cuisine such as soups and hot pot.
